replay: P18 training documents only, half batch from user-requested values course, half from basic Chinese
task: 3 ordered movement events, 6 named objects, 4 locations, 2 distinct objects; one object occurs twice and the other once; question selects either, balanced
split: Disjoint unordered object pairs: sorted pair index modulo 5 in {0,1,2} train, 3 development, 4 test. All symbols seen in train; no same-world split leakage.
new_module: One shared 128-wide, 4-head causal attention/FF block used twice; output projections initialized to zero for an identity start; remaining weights random
supervision: Response-only byte cross-entropy. Trace format: 据:indices;后:latest;答:location。 Programmatic environment labels; no model-generated labels or self-confirmation.
fairness: Same optimizer steps, batch size, task worlds, replay, and seed per arm; response tokens, trainable parameters and compute are NOT matched and are reported
evaluation: Raw greedy byte generation with BOS/PAD masking only; final answer and exact intermediate evidence separately; paired changed query and reversed events; unseen wording; recurrent 1/0-pass inference ablations; no test selection
gates: Finite training, unchanged original tensors/files, exact cold tensor restore; capability requires >=95% answer and paired counterfactual accuracy on all three seeds, and >=95% exact trace for trace arms. No automatic promotion.
scope: Bounded textual working-memory reasoning probe, NOT a new autobiographical episode, proof of faithful private reasoning, broad Chinese competence, or full sleep imagination
